subject: Price query on PO-00102 - Atlantic Seafood Co.
body:
Hello, our records show invoice ASC-9102 for EUR 1,719.00 against PO-00102, which was raised at EUR 1,572.50 for the weekly seafood delivery. That is a difference of EUR 146.50 (+9.3%), above our usual tolerance. Could you confirm the agreed unit price for this delivery, or issue a credit note for the difference? Thank you.

Accounts Payable, Hotel Aurora
